representedDate: Current twin-spire basilica and standing cloister, based on 2023 exterior and current mapping.
wholePhysicalScope: Native BAG-backed basilica multipolygon including original courtyard void, coordinated with the measured church plan and Dutch heritage survey.
lodDetails: All four levels preserve the twin westwork spires, chapel and transept silhouette, curved apse and cloister courtyard. Near levels add the Bergportaal arch, tracery, buttresses and choir arcature.
limitations: Model represents standing exterior and open cloister courtyard. It excludes the adjacent Sint-Janskerk.
Westwork heights follow the recorded measurements and photo silhouette. The apse, small towers, cloister, details, facade finishes and vertical terrain contact are approximate.
Crypt, treasury interiors and relief carvings are outside the exterior scope.
